topic: Data migration from staging to production
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on migrating data for the UK region (7880) from a staging environment to production. Initially, [p1] suggested moving all data together to prevent discrepancies. The model structure was already defined in PostgreSQL.

[me] questioned whether the entire UK or just the mall needed migration. [p1] clarified that only the mall data should be moved, but this change must also reflect on the main dashboard, not just the mall analytics view.

Ultimately, the data transfer was completed and confirmed as working.
decisions: Only mall data needs to be migrated from staging to production for the UK region.
